name: Barbarian audit: Brutal Spirit spell modifier reaches its target spells (#3084)
contract: Audit report #3084 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation.

steps.label: before: 705387 has no modifier for op 8
706653 op 8 percent +25 reaches 705387 (mask selects 8 Barbarian spell(s))
